(3) A sequence of macro shots shows a small ceramic bowl with a sleeping orange cat illustration, followed by a tin of bi-colored freeze-dried cat treats. (4) A cat with gray and white fur sniffs and eats from the tin of treats, highlighting the product's appeal to pets. (5) A hand pours fine golden powder from a small glass bottle over a pile of treats in a bowl, showing the preparation process. (6) The hosts present 'Rich Meat Tubes' in foil packaging, and a tortoiseshell cat is shown licking the creamy treat directly from the tube held by a hand. (7) Three different colored cans of cat food are displayed on a wooden platter, followed by a shot of a tabby cat eating wet food from a saucer. (8) The woman shows five red envelopes and several spring festival couplets with cat-themed designs, then a hand attaches a 'Eat Burst' couplet to a wooden structure. (9) The hosts conclude by holding up all the promotional items and smiling warmly at the camera.
